allies.rationale_text: Base-rates ground monte-carlo-methods in reference classes so simulated inputs are not built from wishful stories alone.

allies.activation_condition: When simulation inputs need to be anchored in empirical frequency data rather than subjective estimates to prevent garbage-in-garbage-out distortion

allies.rationale_text: Game-theory-payoffs helps monte-carlo-methods stress-test adversarial moves and countermoves rather than sampling only passive scenarios.

antagonists.rationale_text: False-precision-avoidance protects monte-carlo-methods from projecting exactness that the input assumptions have not earned.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Monte Carlo distributions can 'create an illusion of precision around fundamentally unquantifiable inputs' — computational rigor can mask input uncertainty.
antagonists.activation_condition: When sophisticated simulation output creates false confidence in precise probability estimates that are ultimately only as reliable as the subjective inputs that seeded them
